//: Typechecks sst.config.ts and infra/ against the SST platform types.
Separate from tsconfig.base.json because these files depend on SST's
globals ($config, sst.aws.*, $interpolate) which are declared in
.sst/platform/config.d.ts — a directory that is gitignored and only exists
after `pnpm sst install`. Folding this into the per-package typecheck would
make every package's typecheck fail on a fresh clone.
`skipLibCheck` is required: the Pulumi AWS provider types are enormous and
checking them adds minutes for no benefit.
